name: Standard-Column Specification Registry
abstract: Registry of reusable schema:PropertyValueSpecification standard column definitions derived from technique TAPP workbooks. Each $def constrains one column of the standards table -- the reference materials a procedure calibrates against. A row of that table is a standard BY the thing it standardizes, so one standard appears once per target and the identifier column is not unique per row. TAPP building blocks reference these definitions via fragment $refs so they resolve locally through the building-block register. The root only hosts $defs; it has no instantiable properties of its own.
